extracted.intended_audience: Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH-style biographical sketches for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and required content for preparing the NIH-format Biographical Sketch for each Senior/Key Personnel and other significant contributors, including required sections, formatting and what to include for each section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The entire Biographical Sketch for each person must follow the specified section order and must not exceed five pages. Adhere strictly to the format specified on the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name, eRA Commons user name, Position title
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME:  eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login):  POSITION TITLE:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the individual's full name, their eRA Commons username (credential), and their current position title at the top of the biosketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training table
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)  INSTITUTION AND LOCATION  DEGREE (if applicable)  Completion Date MM/YYYY  FIELD OF STUDY
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List formal education and training chronologically beginning with undergraduate. Include institution/location, degree (if applicable), completion date (MM/YYYY), and field of study. Add or delete table rows as needed to represent full training history (including residency and postdoctoral training where applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise personal statement that describes the candidate's qualifications, relevant expertise, and how the individual will contribute to the proposed project (including mentoring roles or specific methodological expertise). Use narrative examples from the candidate's past work to support claims about fit and capability.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List professional appointments, secondary/adjunct appointments, and honors/awards with dates. Include leadership roles, editorial/committee service, certifications, and other relevant positions demonstrating experience and standing in the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contributions to Science
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the individual's major scientific contributions in numbered paragraphs. For each contribution, provide a short narrative explaining the work's significance and include representative peer‑reviewed publications (lettered a, b, c, ...) that illustrate the contribution. Optionally provide context such as impact, methods developed, or policy/clinical implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List active (Ongoing Research Support / ACTIVE) and recently completed research support with project/purchase identifiers, dates, funding source, project title, PI, a one‑sentence goal/summary, and the individual's Role (e.g., PI, Co‑I, Site PI). Separate ongoing and completed sections and include the dates and the role for each entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: State the individual's specific role on funded projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Role: Site PI / Role: Co-I / Role: PI (as shown in Research Support entries)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each listed research support entry explicitly state the individual's role and any specific responsibilities. This clarifies contribution and potential conflicts or overlaps with the proposed work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide representative publications with citations
rubrics_metrics.description: List representative publications in the Contributions to Science and elsewhere as full citations (authors, title, journal, date, PMID/PMCID where available).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include complete citations for representative work, and when available include PubMed PMID or PMCID and links (e.g., to MyBibliography). Use lettered sublists (a, b, c...) under each contribution as examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include link to complete bibliography (MyBibliography)
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete List of Published Work in MyBibliography:  http://...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a URL or pointer to the individual's full bibliographic listing (MyBibliography) to allow reviewers to access the complete publication record beyond the representative citations.
